body:
## 概要

オーナーが 2026-09-26 に決めたレビューbotの契約を、AGENTS.md §8 に表で足します。あわせて、2026-09-20 以降に作られた61本のPR（#204〜#331）で、各botが実際にレビューしたか、止まった理由、指摘の数、オーナーのアカウントの判断を数えた表を足します。集計で「対応必要」だった指摘の種類をもとに、末尾の `## Code Review Rules` の項目を補います。

#330（PR #331）で、Devin Review の行の削除、Codex の行の追加、`## Code Review Rules` 節の追加は済んでいます。このPRは、その残りです。

Closes #333

## 変更内容

- [x] §8 に「レビューbotの契約」の表を足した（Cursor Bugbot・CodeRabbit・Codex・Copilot と、解約した Devin Review・Qodo）。契約・プラン・課金の設定はエージェントが変えないことを明記した。
- [x] §8 に「PR #204〜#331 でbotが実際にしたこと」の表と、「対応必要」「対応不要」の内訳を足した。
- [x] これまでの実測の表（PR #274・#306・#331）は記録として残し、前の段落の「6度直している」を「#333 で7度」にした。
- [x] `## Code Review Rules` の P1 に3項目を足し、1項目を広げた：
  - 教員用ガイドの完成チェックや実演で、挙げた観点を確かめられない（PR #228）
  - 教科書のCSSで、本文やSTEPの見出しが隠れる（PR #233。既存のJS・CSSの項目を広げた）
  - 翻訳スクリプトで、訳が消える・巻き戻る、削除したページが残る、未翻訳の文の `lang` が合わない（PR #220・#233・#234）
- [x] 「指摘しない」を4項目にした：完成コードの書き方の方針を変える提案、「初学者向けにかみ砕くべき」という提案、差分に検証の記録がないこと、docstring の網羅率。

## 集計（PR #204〜#331、61本）

範囲：2026-09-20 00:00 UTC 以降に作られたPR（#204〜#331）。subagent 5つで12〜13本ずつ分担し、PRごとにチェック・status・レビュー・レビューコメント・PRコメントを読みました。オーナーのアカウントが貼った内部の報告（翻訳の照合など）は、botの指摘に数えていません。

| bot | レビューした | しなかった理由 | 指摘 | 対応必要 | 任意対応 | 対応不要 | 返信なし |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Cursor Bugbot | 60本 | Draftのまま閉じた（PR #316） | 6 | 6 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| CodeRabbit | 25本 | 枠の上限 29本、レビューが終わる前にマージ 6本、Draft 1本 | 28 | 6 | 3 | 12 | 7 |
| Devin Review | 22本 | trial expired 37本、Draft 1本、解約後 1本 | 14 | 9 | 0 | 4 | 1 |
| Codex | 1本（PR #331） | 有効にする前 60本 | 3 | 3 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Copilot | 0本 | クォータ上限の通知 57本、Draft 1本、投稿なし 3本 | 0 | — | — | — | — |
| Qodo | 0本 | 投稿なし 61本 | 0 | — | — | — | — |

「対応必要」24件の内訳は次のとおりです。

- 翻訳スクリプトの不具合・検査漏れ：10件（PR #220・#233・#234）
- AGENTS.md の手順の誤り・書き漏れ：8件（PR #307・#315・#331）
- 教科書のJS・CSS：2件（PR #233）
- PR本文と差分の食い違い・記載不足：2件（PR #237・#281）
- 教員用ガイド：1件（PR #228）
- 訳文から画面の日本語が消えた：1件（PR #257）

## 判断したこと

- **実測の表と契約の表を分けた**：これまでの表は「Draft中・解除後にどう動くか」の実測です。契約は、オーナーが決めた条件（課金・枠・解約）です。変わる契機が違うので、別の表にしました。
- **集計の数え方**：CodeRabbit の pre-merge checks の警告（Linked Issues の判定不能、Docstring Coverage）も1件ずつ指摘に数えました。そのため、CodeRabbit の件数は「Actionable comments posted」の合計より多くなっています。Bugbot の「レビューした」には、マージの後にチェックが完了したものを含めました（PR #251・#253・#254・#256・#258）。
- **Draftで開いたかは推定**：PR作成時にDraftだったかは、APIからは直接取れません。作成時刻と、botが最初に動いた時刻の差から推定しました。表の数には影響しません。
- **P1 に足した項目**：「対応必要」24件のうち、既存の8項目に当てはまらなかったのは、教員用ガイド（PR #228）、CSS（PR #233）、翻訳スクリプトの訳の消失と `lang`（PR #220・#233・#234）でした。PR本文の食い違い（PR #237・#281）は、Codex がレビューするのはコードの差分なので、P1 には入れていません。
- **「指摘しない」に足した項目**：「対応不要」の多くは、差分に検証の記録がないという指摘と、docstring の網羅率でした。検証の記録はPR本文に書く（§8）ので、指摘しない側に入れました。
- **「初学者向けにかみ砕くべき」**：対象を完成コードに限らず、教科書も含めました。既定の対応は「教科書で説明する」（§11）なので、説明を足す提案も方針の変更にあたると判断しました。教科書の説明が誤っているときは、P1 の「食い違い」として指摘されます。
- **Bugbot の本文への追記の記述は変えていない**：#332 の範囲です。
- **Codex の「P0・P1 だけを指摘する」**：OpenAI のドキュメントにそうありますが、PR #331 では `P2` も1件出ました。両方を書きました（ドキュメントは、この環境のネットワークで遮断されていて読めませんでした。依頼に書かれた内容を元にしています）。このPRでも `P2` が1件出ています。

## Codexの実測（このPR）

時刻はすべて 2026-09-26 UTC です。

| 場面 | Codex | ほかのbot |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Draft中（06:32:37〜06:38:20、約6分） | 何もなし（レビュー・コメント・リアクション・チェックのどれもなし） | CodeRabbit は「Draft PR not reviewed」のコメントだけ（06:32:45）。Bugbot はチェックなし、Copilot は何もなし |
| Draft解除（06:39:10） | 06:42:48 にレビュー1件（3分38秒）。インライン1件（`P2`、日本語、`AGENTS.md reference` 付き）：契約の表の「新しいPRを開いたとき」をDraftでないPRに限る | Bugbot は 06:39:14〜06:41:31 で SUCCESS（指摘なし）。CodeRabbit は 06:43:51 にレビューし、指摘1件（本文の記入予定の欄）。「0 included reviews remain」「1 review per hour」。Copilot は何もなし |
| ffb774d の push（06:46:55） | 06:48:28 に👍（1分33秒）。指摘のスレッドへの返信には 06:47:13 に「To use Codex here, create a Codex account…」 | Bugbot は 06:47:02〜06:48:23 で SUCCESS。CodeRabbit はレビューして指摘なし（「78 included PR review attempts over the past 7 days」「1 review per hour」）。Copilot は何もなし |

Codex は、このリポジトリで自動レビューが動いています（Draftを外したとき・pushのあと）。設定の確認は不要です。

## レビューへの対応

| 指摘 | 判断 | 対応 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Codex（P2）：契約の表の「新しいPRを開いたとき」をDraftでないPRに限る | 対応必要 | ffb774d（CodeRabbit の行も同じ理由で直した） |
| CodeRabbit（Minor）：PR本文の記入予定の欄を実測で埋める | 対応必要 | PR本文を更新（指摘の「Codexは指摘なし」は誤りなので、実測どおり P2 1件と書いた） |

- [x] `python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts -p 'test_*.py'`：143 tests OK

- [x] 2つのコミット（c3e0461・ffb774d）のそれぞれで上の3つが通り、CI（validate-teaching-materials・package）も success

※ リポジトリの方針により、Unit Test は対象外です。

author: kreier
body:
Several stations log millivolts as integers, so the rollups the website reads
were 1000x out: aisvn-solar's solar axis peaked at 4570 instead of 4.6 V, and
phumy2 at 1384. Both now peak at 2.9 V and 3.4 V.

readings stays raw and is never modified. It is the canonical record, and
rewriting it would lose the ability to disagree with a correction. The rollups
are the presentation layer, and a rollup mixing volts and millivolts is worse
than useless. Every converted day records which channels were converted and
which regime rows decided it, in scaled_channels and regime_ids, so a reader can
tell a converted value from a raw one without re-deriving it.

Unconfirmed regimes are still never applied. 11 windows remain unconfirmed, all
of them aisvn, so aisvn's chart still plots raw values -- the rule working, not
an oversight.

aggregate is now a separate stage between regimes and parquet, because applying
a scale needs the regimes table and rolling up inside the ingest built the daily
table before the detector had run. On a clean build that is silently unscaled.
test_ingest_alone_does_not_build_rollups locks the ordering down, and
test_workflows.py now requires any workflow calling verify to run the aggregate
stage.

Three corrections the measurements forced:

- Confirmed regimes are windowed to the channel's extent, not to the detector's
  proposal. phumy2.solar2_v was scaled for its first seven months and raw for
  the following three years, because the proposal stopped there.
- valid_to is now the exclusive end. Writing the last day's own date excluded it
  from a half-open window, which is how aisvn-solar kept a raw 601 V on
  2020-06-12 and phumy2 a raw 1384 V on 2024-02-01.
- The channel map named a rollup column that does not exist in both tables
  (battery_v_avg is hourly-only), and had load_v as a bare string rather than a
  tuple, so it iterated character by character and emitted `SET l = l * ?`. Both
  now go through the table's actual column list.

Also fixes a bug that has been there since the first release:
readings_hourly had no battery_v_max, so the daily battery maximum was being
taken from the hourly minimum.

Baseline: readings and bucket counts unchanged, unconfirmed regimes 14 -> 11 as
the three confirmed channels replace their proposals. 115 tests, 22 frontend
checks.

body:

Этот закомментированный блок в теле Pull Request служит чек-листом для автора и навигатором для ревьюера. Каждый пункт должен давать чёткое понимание контекста изменений.

1. Итог

5. Проверка

7. Интеграция
Что нужно сделать при выкладке в другие окружения — миграции БД, новые переменные окружения, зависимости от других PR.
-->

## Итог

Вторая очередь исправлений по ревью PR #296: закрыты все пункты, вынесенные из #337.
- Repo Map разложен по модулям и получает парсер через протокол `ParserBackend`.
- Bundle ищется один раз за запуск.
- Файлы читаются двумя процессами Git на весь коммит, а отбор в бюджет стал линейным.
- `verify.py` и монолитный `test_clean_room.py` разбиты на пакеты.

Первая очередь (#337) уже влита через #338.

## Затронутые части проекта

- Repo Map: новые модули `policy`, `git_source`, `graph`, `budget`, `cache`, `backend`, `bundle_lock`, `bundle_install`, `bundle_worker`. `repo_map.py` и `parser_bundle.py` стали тонкими, их публичный API сохранён. Изменён `tree_sitter_worker.py`.
- CLI harness: `harness health` и `harness cleanup` (`harness/bin/harness`, `harness/cleanup.py`).
- Оркестрация: `workflow/reports.py`.
- CI: `.github/workflows/verify.yml`, `release-parser-bundle.yml`, `upstream-drift.yml`.
- Скрипты: `scripts/verify.py` и новый пакет `scripts/verification`, `scripts/test_clean_room.py` и новый пакет `scripts/clean_room`, `scripts/diff_coverage.py`.
- Документация: README Repo Map, ADR 0024, archify-диаграммы, `backend-orchestration.md` (обе копии).

## Бизнес-логика

- Карта `full` и карта `minimal` содержат один и тот же набор путей. Бинарные файлы, подмодули и файлы языков без грамматики остаются в `full` без сигнатур.
- Соответствие «расширение → грамматика» задаёт только lock. Если в bundle нет пакета грамматики, пропускаются только файлы этого языка, а не весь разбор.
- Ключ кэша и разбор всегда относятся к одному и тому же найденному bundle.
- При сбое worker причина и последние 4 КБ его stderr сохраняются в `last-worker-error.log` рядом с установкой.
- `harness cleanup` удаляет install-каталоги устаревших lock.
- `harness health` сообщает `tier=minimal`, если в registry лежит bundle без поддерживаемых грамматик (тестовый stub). Кроме того, health предупреждает, когда developer получает полный `verification_commands`.
- Пустой `checks_run` в отчёте разрешён только architect.

## Что изменено

- **SRP:** `parser_bundle.py` стал фасадом над `bundle_lock` (формат lock), `bundle_install` (offline-установка) и `bundle_worker` (протокол `FileFacts` и ограниченный запуск). `repo_map.py` — над `policy`, `git_source`, `graph`, `budget`, `cache` и `backend`. `load_policy` разбит на чтение и проверку, список допустимых полей берётся из `RepoMapPolicy`.
- **DIP:** `build_map(..., backend=ParserBackend)`. Реализация по умолчанию — `BundleParserBackend`, тесты передают свою.
- **Производительность:** `budget.select_within_budget` считает размер кандидата по приращению длины JSON; тест на 25 случайных наборах сверяет результат побайтно с прежним алгоритмом. `git_source.read_blobs` читает всё двумя процессами: `cat-file --batch-check` и `cat-file --batch`.
- **Единый поиск bundle:** `parser_bundle.locate_bundle` возвращает `LocatedBundle` с `identity()` для ключа кэша, а `acquire_bundle(located=...)` принимает его без повторного поиска. Проверка вынесена в `check_bundle`, ею же пользуется `harness health`, поэтому дублированная проверка в CLI убрана.
- **Worker:** запрос несёт `languages` из lock, грамматики грузятся лениво через `importlib`. Если `languages` нет (старый harness), используется совместимая таблица по умолчанию.
- **CI:** задача `parser-bundle` собирает bundle один раз и передаёт его матрице `repo-map-bundle` артефактом. Все actions закреплены по commit SHA.
- **Скрипты:**
  - `scripts/verification`: модули `process`, `text_checks`, `docs_sync`, `vendor_pin`, `instructions`.
  - `scripts/clean_room`: 21 модуль сценариев с `run(ctx)`; входы и выходы каждого сценария перечислены в docstring. Разбиение выполнено инструментом на AST с проверкой замыканий, код сценариев перенесён без изменений.

## Проверка

- `python scripts/verify.py` на итоговом коде, уже после разбиения скриптов: mypy, pytest (303 с) и clean-room (177 с) прошли, итог — `agent-harness verification passed`. Clean-room прошёл все 21 сценарий. Pyflakes-проверки F и E9 по новым модулям чистые.
- С реальным локальным bundle cp314-win_amd64 прошли 154 теста Repo Map по всем языкам, включая новый тест file-scoped namespace в C#. Строгий mypy worker на настоящих грамматиках тоже прошёл.
- Оркестрационные тесты: 134 прошли.
- Archify: обе диаграммы прошли `validate --quality showcase` (0 ошибок, 0 предупреждений), `deliver` завершился с кодом 0, `visual-check` дал `containment: pass`.

## Не проверено и риски

- Задача `parser-bundle` с передачей артефакта и SHA-закреплённые actions проверены только разбором YAML вручную. Подтвердит их первый прогон CI этого PR.
- Изменён SHA-256 `tree_sitter_worker.py`: локальные registry нужно пересобрать. Опубликованных релизов bundle нет.
- Таблица расширений по умолчанию в worker остаётся только для совместимости со старым harness.

## Интеграция

Миграций нет. Локальные registry parser bundle нужно пересобрать через `scripts/build_parser_bundle.py`.

body:
## Scope

Optional local voice input: browser recording -> authenticated voice API -> native SenseVoice/Whisper -> append to the existing draft, never automatically send or invoke an agent. Disabled by default; installation/upgrades keep existing settings unless explicitly changed. No paid speech API is required.

Includes Linux native execution, Windows Job supervision/private temporary files, verified package import, transactional configuration/rollback, installation/upgrade integration, and explicitly opted-in pinned Actions-artifact acquisition. Native model/executable payloads are not included in the application standalone bundle.

This large experimental branch includes product code, research workflows, fixtures and retained evidence (roughly 273 changed files before closeout). Research assets are not product qualification. The packager currently copies the entire scripts/voice source directory, including diagnostic/build helpers, but not downloaded models/native binaries. No unapproved pruning or component replacement was performed.

## Integration and documentation

This repairs the causally reproduced stale-cache path, not a claim about every possible scrolling race.

## Retained bounded diagnostic evidence

Causal evidence is committed in **14c55a7**; controller diagnostic harness **6085155**, pinned products main **638c553** and voice **20f5f0e**. During that diagnosis, instrumentation was applied only to disposable Actions product copies; the subsequently approved repair is recorded above.

- [Initial bounded batch 36225934786](https://github.com/xujxu/agents-chat/actions/runs/36225934786): Windows collection aborted in the added filesystem watcher (Node/libuv assertion), so those arms were invalid. WebKit main passed5/5; voice failed its first repetition at5px vs4px, with4not run. Ordinary typography36225906723 independently failed at16px without geometry sampling.

author: lindkvis
body:
Part of #1520. This adds hand-made workflow sets to the Models shelf, built to the chosen "Workflow Set Menus" design.

**Backend**
- Two hub tables, `model_workflow_set` and `model_workflow_set_member`. They are added to the re-run v2 list rather than as a new schema version.
  - Members are stored by sha256, in fixed slots, with at most one checkpoint.
  - A member whose file leaves the shelf stays in the set as "not on shelf" and reconnects when the file comes back.
- Five new routes, all owner-only: create, rename, delete (which returns a snapshot for undo), add members, and remove members. Each is declared in `ROUTE_POLICIES`, has a row in the coverage matrix, and is tested in both directions.
- `GET /models/workflow-sets` now also returns `hand_made`, plus a `covered_by` list on each combination.
  - A combination is covered when every one of its models is in the set.
  - Evidence cards are built only from combinations no set covers.
- Clone with new models: a set's VAE and text encoder members come first, as `via: "grouped"`. They are pre-picked only when the set offers exactly one file of that layout.

**Frontend**
- A "＋ New workflow set" tile (also the **N** key) and dashed hand-made cards in the same grid. Each card says "Grouped by you", and "Incomplete: no checkpoint" when it has no checkpoint.
- A tray with five slots. Each slot's ＋ opens a type-to-filter popup, ranked as the design ranks it, where one click adds a model. The Checkpoint popup closes after its pick; the other slots stay open for the next click. The tray also has **Fill from pictures** and **Fill from a set** (pre-ticked checklists).
- When a checkpoint with no base model goes in, the tray offers once to set it (pre-filled with the shelf's guess), since the suggestions follow it.
- Sets are selected as sets, in their own pill (Rename, Delete set). Selecting files clears the set selection, and the other way round.
- The shelf menu gains **Remove from set** and **New workflow set with this checkpoint**.
- Every set change gets a receipt with Undo.
- The file-delete prompt names the sets that will keep the file as "Not on shelf".

**Where this differs from the design or the issue**
- Not done here: Merge sets and the lasting Merge offer (#1523), the "Grouped by you" option in Show, sorting by Date created or Last used, and LoRA choices in Clone. Clone proposes only VAEs and text encoders today.
- The issue says an emptied set is deleted. The design makes empty sets from the tile, so emptying a set keeps it.
- Evidence cards still select their checkpoint file. Only hand-made cards select as sets.
- The chooser is a popup anchored to the tile. Its list height and the slot label column use raw widths, which are left for the planned UI consistency pass.

**From the pre-push review**
- Fixed:
  - Pre-picking is now per encoder layout, so a Flux clip_l plus t5 pair both pre-pick.
  - Undo can no longer lose a set: undoing a create goes through the delete, which has its own Undo, and a snapshot re-post no longer re-applies kind rules.
  - A multi-set delete with one failure keeps its Undo for the rest.
  - Set selection is cleared when leaving the grid and when entering a tray, so Delete on a member is the file delete.
  - Fill from pictures no longer offers a second checkpoint.
  - Holding N no longer creates a set per key repeat.
  - Stale comments and doc lines updated.
- Not changed: the reviewer noted that the negative authz tests get their 403 from the READ-token non-GET belt before the gate runs. That is true of every share token this suite can mint. What pins the policy is `test_every_shelf_route_is_declared_owner_only`, which covers all five routes.

body:
## Summary

Bump the Django pin from 5.2.11 to 5.2.17, the latest release in the 5.2 LTS series. This fixes all 18 open Dependabot alerts against Django 5.2.11 (3 high, 5 medium, 10 low). No other package versions change.

## Behaviour changes in 5.2.12–5.2.17

Every change in these releases is a security fix. The ones that alter behaviour are confined to features this app doesn't use (ASGI request handling, cache middleware / `cache_page`, GIS, signed cookies, `URLField` / `list_editable` / generic inlines in the admin). The one feature in use that's touched is SMTP with `EMAIL_USE_TLS`: a failed STARTTLS handshake now closes the connection instead of continuing unencrypted.

- `uv pip compile` for Linux / Python 3.11 resolves to the same package set as production except `django==5.2.17`.
- Deployed from this branch and checked the site before merging.

author: openhubris
body:
Fixes #243

When Jev cannot serve a fight for reasons that have nothing to do with the target, `fight` and `cycle` now say so and fail, and a cycle keeps its queue.

- `src/wow/jev-failure.ts` classifies Jev failures. HTTP 401/402/403 become `JevUnavailableError` with the `error_type` read from the response body (`jev_unavailable: HTTP 402 billing_error`); without a readable body the status name is used (`payment_required`). Network errors, 429 and 5xx become `JevTransportError`. A missing key is `jev_unavailable: missing_jev_key`.
- `TacticsLoop` retries a transport failure in-fight and only after `TRANSPORT_LIMIT = 3` in a row ends the run with `jev_unavailable: transport <error> (3 in a row)`. Any answered request resets the count. The request timeout (`jev_timeout`, #166/#174) is untouched. A `jev_unavailable` end rejects `start`, so `fight` replies `ERR jev_unavailable: …` (exit 1, `--json` error envelope).
- `EncounterCycleRuntime` stops with `stopCause: "jev_unavailable"` and `stopDetail.reason`, leaves the current and later targets `queued` (index unchanged), and `cycle`/`cycle --resume` reject with the same message. Target-specific failures still skip and advance. `cycling` prints `Stop reason: jev_unavailable (HTTP 402 billing_error)`.
- `JEV_FAULT=http:<status>` (now 400-599) and `transport` go through the real client with an injected `fetch`, so they are classified exactly like real replies.
- Docs: manual, SKILL.md, README, help, and the M2 fault runbook's 3A/3B expectations.

## Proof

Unit: `src/wow/encounter-cycle-jev.test.ts` drives a real `TacticsLoop` + cycle through `createFaultSelect(parseJevFault("http:402"), selectJevAction)`: `start` rejects with `jev_unavailable: HTTP 402 payment_required`, `stopCause` `jev_unavailable`, `currentIndex` 0, all three targets `queued`; then with Jev back `resume` fights the same first target and all three end `done`. A missing key stops the same way. `src/wow/jev-failure.test.ts` covers 402 `billing_error`, 401 `authentication_error`, 403 without body, 429/500/503 as transport, 422 plain. `src/wow/jev-fault.test.ts` covers 402 ending at once, 503 and network failures ending after three, and two transport failures followed by a completed fight.

Live, real endpoint (TypeSafe currently answers every request with HTTP 402), own `eversong10` character Fgklhggfefj (account FAC6AB7665459), Eversong Woods. The endpoint itself:

```
$ curl -s -w '\nHTTP %{http_code}\n' -X POST https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone -H "Authorization: Bearer $TYPESAFE_API_KEY" ...
{"detail":{"error_type":"billing_error","message":"Your organization has no available TypeSafe API credits. ..."}}
HTTP 402
```

This branch's daemon, Springpaw Stalker `0xf130003d2307e285` (f=38) and Crazed Dragonhawk `0xf130003d2207e329` (f=7, #135):

```
$ tuicraft fight 0xf130003d2307e285; echo rc=$?
ERR jev_unavailable: HTTP 402 billing_error
rc=1
$ tuicraft fight 0xf130003d2307e285 --json; echo rc=$?
{"command":"fight","data":null,"error":{"message":"jev_unavailable: HTTP 402 billing_error","stage":"command"},"events":[],"kind":"error"}
rc=1
$ tuicraft tactics --json | jq -c '.data | {status,lastStopReason,lastOutcome}'
{"status":"idle","lastStopReason":"failed","lastOutcome":{"status":"failed","reason":"jev_unavailable: HTTP 402 billing_error"}}

$ tuicraft cycle 0xf130003d2207e329 0xf130003d2307e285 0xf130003d2207e329; echo rc=$?
ERR jev_unavailable: HTTP 402 billing_error
rc=1
$ tuicraft cycling
Cycle: stopped
Instruction: defeat the selected target while keeping the character alive
Starts: 2/10
Resumes: 0
Target 0xf130003d2207e329: skipped (unverified_hostile_relation)
Target 0xf130003d2307e285: queued (unknown)
Target 0xf130003d2207e329: queued (unknown)
Stop reason: jev_unavailable (HTTP 402 billing_error)
```

author: spider2449
body:
## Summary

- keep Knife active after every completed segment so the next click continues cutting without pressing `K` again
- add Knife-specific target snapping with `Vertex + Edge` and `Edge only` modes
- allow Knife to start directly by clicking an existing logical vertex; no preselection is required
- add a live 3D hover preview before clicks commit topology:
  - a highlighted candidate point follows the logical edge
  - near a logical vertex, the candidate snaps exactly onto that vertex
  - once a start anchor exists, a temporary line previews the pending cut segment
- use the exact same Knife picker for hover and click so the displayed candidate is the committed candidate
- support continuous segment combinations: vertex -> vertex, vertex -> edge, edge -> vertex, and edge -> edge
- promote every committed edge point to a true logical vertex and preserve shared logical topology
- remap completed anchors by geometry position so continuous cutting survives renderer retessellation and logical ID changes
- keep each committed segment constrained to one unambiguous logical face, while allowing the path to continue through the new endpoint into another incident face
- keep preview helpers out of scene snapshots/history and clear them on `Esc` / Edit Mode teardown
- add topology, viewport, continuous-path, hover-preview, snap-control, undo, and context-menu coverage

## Interaction

1. Enter Edit Mode -> Vertex.
2. Press `K` or choose RMB -> Knife.
3. Choose `Knife Snap`:
   - `Vertex + Edge` (default): near a logical vertex, snap exactly to it; otherwise use the edge position.
   - `Edge only`: only interior edge positions are accepted.
4. Move the mouse:
   - before the first click, a highlighted point shows the exact candidate start
   - after a start anchor exists, a highlighted endpoint and temporary line show the exact pending segment
5. Click to accept that candidate.
6. The endpoint automatically becomes the next segment's start.
7. Continue moving/clicking without pressing `K` again.
8. Press `Esc` to end Knife and clear its preview.

A single preselected logical vertex can still be used as the initial anchor.

## Deliberate limits

- targets are existing logical vertices or points on existing logical edges
- no arbitrary face-interior points yet
- each committed segment cuts one logical face
- no drag-stroke Knife
- segments commit as they are completed; `Esc` exits the tool rather than confirming a deferred batch

## Windows-local validation required

Validate exact PR HEAD on `F:\coding\otherPrj\webgl`:

```powershell
npm run build
npx playwright test tests/cut-edge-endpoint.spec.ts tests/context-menu.spec.ts --workers=1
npm test -- --workers=2
```

Manual checks:

### Live hover + vertex snap

1. Cube -> Edit Mode -> Vertex.
2. Press `K` with `Knife Snap = Vertex + Edge`.
3. Move the mouse along a visible logical edge without clicking.
4. Confirm the candidate point follows the edge.
5. Move onto a logical vertex and confirm the candidate snaps exactly onto it.
6. Click the start.
7. Move toward another edge/vertex and confirm a temporary line follows from the anchor to the candidate.
8. Click to commit, then continue without pressing `K` again.
9. Press `Esc`; preview point/line must disappear.

### Edge-only snap

1. Set `Knife Snap = Edge only`.
2. Start Knife.
3. Move near a vertex along an edge.
4. Confirm the candidate remains an interior edge point rather than snapping to the vertex.

GitHub-side edits have not run Windows-local build or Playwright.

author: dlddu-k3s-homelab-k3s-mcp[bot]
body:
## 무엇을
`prd-approval-gate` AC1 의 「선언되지 않은 쌍을 행사하는 도구는 등록 자체가 거부된다」가 **구현돼 있지 않음**을 등재하고, 약속을 낮추는 대신 **구현 명세를 올린다**. 코드 변경은 없다 — 구현은 `tbm_homelab-k3s-mcp-docs-impl` 이 이어받는다.

## 발견
- 기동 검사 `mcp.Validate()` → `validateRegistry` 는 등록 표 ↔ tools/list **이름 일치와 핸들러 존재만** 본다. `toolDeclaration.pairs` 가 비어도 통과한다.
- 로컬 프로브(main `0bc77de`, 커밋하지 않음): 선언 없이 쿠버네티스에 닿는 가짜 도구 → `validateRegistry` **수용**(기동 성공), gatekeeper 없는 상태에서 호출 → 거부 없이 **k8s 호출 1회**.
- 그래서 `test-approval-gate.md#시나리오 1` 의 ⏳ 행은 「(c) 를 태울 훅의 소관 판정」을 기다리고 있었지만, 훅을 세워도 (c) 는 **실패**한다. 실체는 PRD ↔ 구현 불일치(docs-impl 소관)이고, 매트릭스 「✅ 완전」이 이를 놓쳤다.

## 결정 (제품 소유자, 2026-09-26)
문면을 실제 수준으로 낮추지 않고 구현을 올린다. AC1 에 두 겹을 명세했다.
1. **기동 시** — 모든 도구는 쌍 선언(고정 또는 인자 도출) **또는** 「자원 권한 미행사」 명시 표식(사유 포함, discovery 포함) 중 **정확히 하나**. 아니면 기동 실패. 빈 선언 ≠ 표식.
2. **호출 시** — 핸들러의 쿠버네티스 클라이언트를 그 호출의 선언 쌍으로 제한. 선언 밖 요청은 apiserver 전에 거부되고 호출은 실패. 게이트 자신의 사전 읽기(AC11)는 별개.

검증 방법도 맞췄다: 무선언 가짜 도구 → 기동 실패 / A 선언·B 행사 가짜 도구 → B 호출 0·실패 / 출하 도구 전부 기동 검사 통과·정상 호출이 제한에 걸리지 않음.

## 변경
- `docs/prd-approval-gate.md` AC1 설명·검증 방법.
- `docs/doc-tracker/2026-09.md`: 매트릭스 approval-gate `✅ 완전` → `⚠️ 구현 미충족`, 시나리오 1 구현 대기 행 근거 정정(해제 조건 ⑷ docs-impl 구현 → ⑸ 이 렌즈의 관측 수단), 변경 이력 1행. 집계는 그대로.

## 다음
- docs-impl 감지가 PRD ↔ 구현 불일치로 `action_required` → 구현(기동 검사 + 범위 제한 클라이언트 래퍼 + 단위 테스트). 기존 25개 도구 선언이 실제 행사와 어긋나면 그때 드러나며, 선언을 고친다.
- 그 뒤 scenario-e2e 가 시나리오 1 (c) 의 관측 수단을 정한다. 테스트 문서의 (c) 문면에 「호출 제한」 갈래를 넣는 것도 그 렌즈 몫이다.

## 확인
`check_doc_inventory.py`·`check_mock_policy.py`·`check_comment_policy.py`·`check_ac_mapping.py` 로컬 rc=0.

## Summary

- Move the canonical npm CLI package from the rejected unscoped `virune` name to `@virune/cli`.
- Preserve the installed executable name `virune`.
- Advance the bootstrap candidate identity to `1.1.0-rc.1` instead of mutating the already-partially-published rc.0 identity.
- Align publication planning, release tarball identity, generated projects, public Registry verification, npm exec/global-install paths, and focused tests.

## Related issue

Closes #707.
Related to #358 and #518.

## Why

The authenticated rc.0 bootstrap successfully created the five dependency packages, but npm rejected the unscoped `virune` CLI package with HTTP 403 because its name is too similar to an existing package. The owned `@virune` scope does not have that unscoped-name collision.

## Validation

- Focused release/package/generated-project tests are included in the diff.
- Formal repository CI must validate the exact PR head.
- No npm Registry write is performed by this PR.

## Compatibility / safety

- Language semantics, Compiler API, Runtime ABI, and Interop ABI are unchanged.
- The command remains `virune`; only the npm package acquisition name changes to `@virune/cli`.
- Historical v1.0.x GitHub Release tarball behavior remains separate from the Registry-enabled path.
- Already-published `1.1.0-rc.0` package bytes are not modified or republished.

author: thetruekoschei
body:
RULES COMPLIANCE

Replaced the map's boundary data. The previous file came from a repository that is MIT-licensed but whose geographic data is GADM, whose licence forbids redistribution - so committing it here was not permitted under the "assets must be licensed properly" rule. It is now Natural Earth admin-1, which is public domain, and is better on the merits: current state and UT names (Odisha, Uttarakhand, Telangana, Ladakh as separate units), and 76 KB instead of 139 KB.

README now carries the four required sections - team name and members, problem statement, tech stack, setup instructions - plus an explicit AI-assistance declaration as the rules require, a licence column for every dependency, and a data-sources table covering the boundary file and the typefaces. Team member names are left as placeholders to fill in.

NEW CAPABILITY

Analogue discovery. The substitution table can only match a stream it already knows, which is precisely why the hidden exchanges stay hidden. Every material now carries a profile of 11 indicative properties, and an unplaced stream is compared against all 35 profiles by weighted Euclidean distance. Deterministic and offline - no model, no embeddings - and each suggestion names the properties that agree and the one that does not, so it can be argued with. Bottom ash resolves to fly ash at 96%, jarosite to FGD gypsum on sulphur and bulk density, cement kiln dust to the lime-bearing streams. The profiles are indicative typical compositions, stated as such, and feed nothing but the resemblance ranking.

Multi-hop chains. A depth-first walk over the match graph finds a plant that both receives a by-product and places its own - the arrangements an industrial park is built around, invisible to pair-at-a-time scoring. Each hop must move a different material and no facility may repeat. Ranked by the weakest link.

Network optimisation. The greedy allocation takes matches best score first, which is feasible but not optimal, since score measures practicality rather than value. The allocation is now also solved as a linear program (SciPy HiGHS) maximising total net value subject to every supplier's output, every receiver's intake and each receiver's per-material ceiling. Worth Rs 289.72 Cr a year more than greedy on the sample registry, and it drops every loss-making exchange to zero on its own rather than by a rule. Falls back to greedy, and says so, if SciPy is absent.

Rail against road. Rail is offered at Rs 1.9/tonne-km plus Rs 420/tonne of terminal handling covering both road legs, and is taken only above 400 km and 20,000 t/yr and only when genuinely cheaper door to door. 25 of 75 matches switch to rail.

Circularity and impact. Share of by-product tonnage that finds a home, landfill diverted, virgin material avoided and CO2, on either the greedy or the optimised plan. The denominator is every tonne offered, unplaced streams included, so it is deliberately hard to move. Water footprint is deliberately not modelled - there is no defensible per-tonne figure for most of these streams and inventing one would undermine the numbers that are defensible.

New "Chains & impact" tab carries the rollup, the optimiser-against-greedy comparison and the chains; analogues appear in Gap analysis, where the question they answer is asked; transport mode appears in the ranked table and the audit.

19 further tests (81 total): rail is only chosen when it genuinely undercuts road, transport cost includes terminal handling, every knowledge base material has a well-formed profile, similarity is symmetric and bounded, every unplaced stream gets at least one analogue with recorded uses, chains never repeat a facility and every link is a real match, the optimiser respects all three constraint families and is never worse than greedy, and circularity reconciles against what the registry actually produces.

author: reederphill
body:
Closes #83.

Stacked on #218 (branch ticket-82-race-area-land-contact); review range: ticket-82-race-area-land-contact...ticket-83-three-venue-files. Merge after it.

## What
- **Three venue files**, bundled in RegattaCore (`Resources/venues/`, already copied for the app and the server). Each has two pairings on the schema-2 conditions, and each pairing has an anchor, a mean and trend direction, and its own geographic grid (#10). The files also have land polygons and landmark assets from `docs/assets-manifest.md` (#53). No placeholders.
  - `hollin-bay@1` "Hollin Bay", the open bay and control venue. Classic oscillating is 262°, Sea breeze is 218° and veers. The shore curves round the north and east. Land is downwind in both pairings, so over the race areas the wind is within 1 % and 1° of the open bay's. No current.
  - `saltings-reach@1` "Saltings Reach", the tidal estuary. Classic oscillating is 252°, blowing down the reach, so the course runs along the channel. Gusty offshore is 348°, off the north bank, so the course crosses the channel. A meandering channel about 8.8 m deep runs down the reach, with mudflats to the north bank and a narrower shelf to the south. Peak is 2 kn (#14 keeps the estuary's 2 kn). Tide clock 19x, any tide state at the gun, Manning exponent 0.6667, shallows lead 20°. A headland eddy of 0.5 kn sits on the south bank.
  - `fellmere@1` "Fellmere", the hill-ringed lake: four shore polygons meeting at the lake's N/W/S/E points. Light and patchy is 205°, Gusty offshore is 292°. The windward hills shade the wind by up to 43 % close in to them. Over the race areas the wind is 5–19 % down and bends by up to 6°. No current.
  - The grids come from the land: shadow fades over the upwind fetch to land, the wind bends near the shores to either side, and it slows a little approaching land downwind. I generated the values once with a script outside the repo and checked them in as data; the files' notes say what each grid holds.
- **`VenueTools`**, a new library target (RegattaCore only, never used at race time):
  - `VenuePairingCase` holds a venue × conditions pairing with the default boat class and rules. It gives the seeded rotations (±`WindSetup.meanDirectionSpread`). It also gives the longest course (the longest `CourseLayout.beat` for any strength in the conditions' range, laps 1–2, the line for 16 boats) and the shortest course (the shortest beat, 2 boats). `ShippedVenues` lists the three venues and their six pairings.
  - `VenueOfflineCheck.problems` checks every 0.5° of rotation:
    - the longest course's race area stays clear of land (`RaceArea.overlaps` from #82) and inside the geographic grid and the current grid;
    - every mark and line end of the longest and the shortest course keeps 50 m from land;
    - at a venue with current, both race areas hold channel water (≥ 80 % of the deepest node) and shallows (wet, ≤ 40 %).
  - `VenueSailability.report` checks every 1° of rotation, at the local peak flood and peak ebb, in a 25 % lull on the conditions' lightest strength. Progress at a point is the polar's best upwind VMG in the local wind (after the grid's speed factor) plus the current along the local upwind (after the grid's bend). This is analytic: no race is sailed. It needs the least progress anywhere in the race area to be > 0, and the most progress on the beat to be ≥ 1 kn.
  - `VenueOverview` draws a palette map of each pairing: land, depth tint in five bands, the race area at 0° and ±10°, marks, the start line, the anchor and landmarks. `IndexedImage.png` is a pure-Swift PNG encoder (fixed-Huffman deflate with run and row-above matches), so the maps render the same way on Linux.
- **`regatta-venue-png [<dir>]`** is a thin executable over `VenuePNGCommand`. It writes the six PNGs into `docs/venues/` (checked in, 8–15 KB each), for #84. It is a dependency of `RegattaCoreTests`, so `swift test` builds it.
- **`CourseLayout.derive(axis:anchor:beat:land:fleetSize:laps:boatClass:rules:)`** is a new overload, split out of `derive(windSetup:…)`, which now calls it. It lets the tools lay courses at chosen rotations and beats. Races derive the same courses, bit for bit.
- Docs: `docs/venue-file.md` lists the new venues and the `land-in-race-area@1` fixture, and has a new "Offline checks (#83)" section. The README lines are updated. `dev-venue@1` is no longer described as the app's stand-in.

## Acceptance → test
| Item | Test |
|---|---|
| Check passes for all 6 venue × conditions pairings | RegattaCore: `VenueOfflineCheckTests.offlineCheckPassesForAllSixBundledPairings` (also pins the six pairings to #12's table) |
| Check fails on a fixture with land inside the race area | RegattaCore: `VenueOfflineCheckTests.offlineCheckFailsWhenLandIsInsideTheRaceArea` (fixture `Tests/RegattaCoreTests/Resources/venues/land-in-race-area@1.json`) |
| displayNames == "Hollin Bay", "Saltings Reach", "Fellmere" | RegattaCore: `VenueFileTests.bundledVenueDisplayNamesMatchTheShipNames` (also checks pairings, that landmark assets are in the manifest and on land, and pins the hashes) |
| Sailability passes for all 6 pairings | RegattaCore: `VenueSailabilityTests.sailabilityPassesForAllSixPairings` |
| `docs/venues/` has 6 PNGs | RegattaCore: `RegattaVenuePNGTests.rendersOnePNGPerPairingIntoDocsVenues` (runs `regatta-venue-png` into a temp dir; the checked-in names and sizes must match) |
| Build: estuary is the only venue with current, tidal, 2 kn peak | RegattaCore: `VenueOfflineCheckTests.estuaryIsTheOnlyVenueWithCurrent` |
| Build: sailability is the lulled VMG plus current (flood down the course, ebb up it) | RegattaCore: `VenueSailabilityTests.progressWithoutCurrentIsTheLulledVMG`, `VenueSailabilityTests.estuaryChannelCurrentRunsDownAndUpTheCourse` |
| Build: longest course (360 m beat cap) holds the shortest at every rotation | RegattaCore: `VenueOfflineCheckTests.longestCourseHoldsTheShortest`, `VenueOfflineCheckTests.rotationsSpanTheSeededSpreadBothEndsIncluded` |
| Build: PNG encoder writes valid files | RegattaCore: `RegattaVenuePNGTests.pngHeaderAndChecksumsAreRight`, `RegattaVenuePNGTests.pngDecodesPixelForPixel` (ImageIO, Apple platforms only), `RegattaVenuePNGTests.overviewShowsLandWaterDepthAndTheCourse` |

No UI tests.

Sailability margins (worst progress anywhere / most progress on the beat, in the lull at peak current):
- Hollin Bay: 2.84 / 2.87 kn (Classic), 3.32 / 3.33 kn (Sea breeze).
- Saltings Reach: 0.87 / 2.07 kn (Classic, peak flood running down the course), 3.07 / 3.38 kn (Gusty).
- Fellmere: 1.64 / 1.92 kn (Light and patchy), 3.35 / 3.59 kn (Gusty).

## Assumptions
- **`RaceFiles.defaults` stays on `dev-venue@2`.** The ticket takes `dev-venue@1` out of app use. The app already sails @2 (since #77/#81), so no default-race input changes; picking one of the real venues is #131's practice setup. `dev-venue@1.json` stays bundled because ADR 0004 files are immutable, and `VenueTests` still pins it.
- "Race area clear of land" is read literally: the longest course's rectangle, at every rotation, overlaps no land polygon. Races then never trim these venues' race areas; the trimming from #82 remains for other venues.
- The longest beat covers laps 1–2: the first race sails one (#23), every other race two (#8). Every pairing's longest beat is the 360 m cap (#14: "a beat of about 360 m"). The shortest course (2 laps, the lightest wind, 2 boats) is used for the mark-clearance and channel/shallows checks.
- "Channel" means depth ≥ 80 % of the deepest node, and "shallows" means wet and ≤ 40 %. Mark clearance is 50 m. These are tuning constants on `VenueOfflineCheck`.
- Sailability measures progress along the local upwind (the mean turned by the seed rotation and the grid's bend), where both tacks make the same progress. "At peak current" means each point's own local peak, with the shallows lead included. The lull is 25 % off the conditions' lowest strength (#14's "9 kn × 0.75"). author: yan-h
body:
Fixes #1073

## Semantics (Yan's decision: fan out per voice)

A later tuning expression (CLAP expression kind 2) can use wildcards (`-1` for id, port, channel or key) that reach more than one held voice in one Tune source.
When it does, it now moves every one of those voices, and each keeps its own frozen correction:

- **Tune (`Tune::resolve` + `Tune::fan_out`)**: if the reached voices' frozen corrections differ, the Tune sends one expression per voice.
  Each copy carries that voice's own note id, port 0, channel and key, and its value is the player's value plus that voice's correction.
- **When all the corrections are equal**, one wildcard is already right for every voice, so it is still sent once under the player's own address, with the shared correction added.
  This covers every voice under Retune off, so Retune off stays a pure passthrough.
  It also keeps reaching the instrument's releasing voices, which the Tune no longer holds.
  A per-voice copy would miss those; this difference remains in the case where the corrections do differ.
- **Hub (`Hub::apply`)**: a tuning expression reaching several voices is applied to each one at its own address, producing one `NoteDelta` per voice.
  This is the same pattern a channel termination already uses.
  It happens whether the Tune fanned out or sent the equal-correction wildcard, so the drawn pitch matches the sounding pitch either way.
  `State::on_channel` became `State::select(pick, out)` so both callers can share it.
- **Unchanged**: a wildcard that reaches exactly one voice (or none), an expression addressed to a single note, and source isolation (only the source's own held voices are considered).
- **Other expression kinds (volume, brightness, pressure, …)** go through the same `resolve` path.
  They carry no correction, so they are still forwarded as a single wildcard event.
  `Tune::tuned` only reaches voices for kind 2.

## Capacity and fallback

This follows the existing rule for the tuning expression that accompanies an onset in `Tune::emit`:

- The per-callback limit (`EMIT_PER_CALLBACK`) is checked once per delay-line entry.
  A fan-out that has started finishes, so it can go past the limit by at most `HELD_PER_SOURCE - 1` events.
  An onset's accompanying expression already goes past it by one.
- If the host refuses the **first** copy, nothing has been emitted: the entry stays in the line and is retried next callback, as for any refused event.
- If the host refuses a **later** copy, only that voice misses its update and `DROPPED` is raised.
  The copy is not replayed, because the entry is already spent and replaying it would resend every copy the host accepted.
- The Hub's schedule still shows the refused voice as moved.
  That is the documented cost of the display showing the schedule rather than a confirmation of what the host accepted.

## Tests

- `musical_tests::a_wildcard_tuning_expression_reaches_every_held_voice_with_its_own_correction` is the production-routed reproduction the issue asked for.
  It runs three Tunes and a Hub with just intonation.

author: jessgibson
body:
## Summary

Five commits on top of the Version 14 release (`750a6c5`). The first four are the earlier QA and docs cleanup. The last one (`97a40fc`) works through the Version 14 change brief. Most of the bugs it fixes were already on `main` before this branch.

### Earlier commits
- Align Version 14 QA behaviour: resume and new-initiative routing, canvas only when asked for, Windows Downloads fallback, calendar timezone.
- Workboard upgrade backs up old action files. The installer runs the same migration, and the overlay zip is rebuilt.
- Remove references to skills that don't ship, and make the Version 14 docs generic.
- Clean up leftovers: Jira templates fallback, the stray "NP" marker, and what `[BA name]` maps to.

### Change brief (`97a40fc`)
- **Jira DoR gate** (`hooks/jira-dor-gate.py`)
  - Story creates made through Runlayer's `execute_tool` / `createJiraIssue` are now checked.
  - The gate reads the final `result` of a DoR check, so a story that failed once and then passed is no longer blocked.
  - It reads the flat `issueTypeName` field, so a Bug that mentions a story is allowed.
  - A payload that isn't a JSON object is allowed.
  - Initiatives are found under `~/.cursor/initiatives` or `paths.initiativesRoot` with no environment variable set.
  - 7 new test cases, 20 in total.
- **Missing Python**
  - Mac/Linux: the installer wraps the gate command, so a missing interpreter allows MCP calls instead of blocking all of them. A crash of the script itself still blocks.
  - Windows: if the `py` launcher isn't there at install time, the gate is registered as fail-open and the installer prints a warning.
- **Hooks config**
  - Removed the `sessionStart` prompt hook.
  - A reinstall now replaces the old package prompt entry instead of adding a second copy.
  - Fixed the `hooks.json` comment and the gate comment that described the wrong setting.
- **Initiatives folder:** `session-init.py` and `inject-state-reminder.py` read `paths.initiativesRoot` and `~/.cursor/initiatives`. The old folder names still work as fallbacks. Debrief reads from the initiatives folder, and its keyword table is gone.
- **Shared repo path:** `/handover` stores it as `paths.sharedRepoRoot` in `ba-assistant-config.mdc`, and the leak guard reads it from there. The guard does nothing until a path is set.
- **`/wrap`, end of day, retro**
  - `/wrap` is a chat-only checkpoint in every file that describes it.
  - "Done for tonight" and "end of day" go to `/workboard end-of-day`.
  - A retro runs only on `/retro` or when the user asks for one.
- **`/validate-state`** writes what the chat captured into the initiative files and `ba-actions`. It no longer says "read-only" anywhere.
- **End-of-day mail:** removed the call to `scan-outlook-mail.py`, which was never committed. It now does a light Outlook check through MCP if connected, and otherwise says "Mail: unable to check" and carries on.
- **Upgrade** (`tools/upgrade-ba-assistant.py`)
  - Now copies hook scripts, merges `hooks.json`, installs every command (including `close.md`), and updates the companion skills and workboard helper scripts.
  - Still never touches the profile, the config, initiatives, or `_workstream` data.
- **DoR writer:** `ba-story-writing` writes `dorChecks` (`storyTitle`, `storyKey` if known, `result`) at the same time as the tracker register. The tracker's DoR register gets matching columns.
- **Skills and config**
  - Every sub-skill has `name`, `description` and `disable-model-invocation: true`. This includes `ba-install`, which was set to `false` before.
  - The personal config template has `alwaysApply: true`.
  - `critical-gates.mdc` now says the stop nudge is off unless `stopFollowup: true`.
- **Paths and bootstrap:** commands and routing use `~/.cursor/skills/ba-assistant/...`. Bootstrap and `/reanchor` no longer read the whole `hook-contracts.md`.
- **Genericised examples:** replaced personal product and team names with placeholders. The README credit is now "Built by Jess Gibson."
- **Conformance:** two new checks, one for a mail script that is referenced but missing, and one for command paths without the `~/.cursor/` prefix.

### Existing installs
The upgrader never overwrites `ba-profile.mdc`. Anyone already installed needs to hand-edit the `/wrap` and `/validate-state` rows in it. The CHANGELOG says how.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3 hooks/tests/test_jira_dor_gate.py`: 20/20 pass. The new cases fail against the old gate.
- [x] `python3 tools/conformance-check.py --root .`: 0 FAIL. Both new checks FAIL against the old tree.
- [x] Installed twice into a scratch Cursor home: no duplicate prompt hook, and user prompt entries are kept.
- [x] Upgraded an old install: `close.md` and hook scripts installed; profile, config, initiatives and `ba-actions.json` unchanged.
- [x] Ran the wrapped DoR gate command with Python present (still denies a Story with no DoR pass) and with Python missing (allows).
- [x] Shared-repo guard: allows with no path or an empty path, denies a leaky commit when a path is set.
- [ ] Windows: the missing-`py` fallback was not tested (no Windows machine available).

author: fxavier
body:
Refs #153

Entrega a Demonstração de Fluxos de Caixa pelo método indirecto (ADR-0037 com a Emenda 2026-09-25, **Aceite**). Até aqui não existia em camada nenhuma. O trabalho correu pelo grafo `.claude/grafos/dfc.md`: cada ticket tem um oráculo escrito antes do código por um verificador que não é o autor, e cada nó de autor passou por verificação de adulteração (PV) e revisão em dois eixos num subagente novo.

## O que entra

| Área | Conteúdo |
|---|---|
| ADR-0037 | Emenda E1–E6: mapeamento versionado com validação, rubrica `CAIXA`, limites num só exercício e N-1 homólogo, exportação só em PDF, permissão `:validar`, enum `PENDING`/`VALIDATED` |
| Schema | Migrações `22b` (rubricas, mapeamento conta→rubrica, versões do mapeamento) e `22c` (semeia as rubricas e a versão 1 nos tenants que já existem) |
| Seed | 19 rubricas SISTEMA e as 435 contas folha do PGC mapeadas. As contas de caixa são 111, 121, 122 e 123. A tabela, com a justificação de cada conta, está em `docs/handoff/dfc-seed.md` |
| Núcleo e serviço | `dfc.model.ts` (puro) e `dfc.service.ts`: `gerarDFC` com a articulação sempre verificada (`DFC_NAO_ARTICULA`). Quando há impedimentos, lista-os todos de uma vez e não produz mapa |
| Configuração | `/contabilidade/fluxo-caixa/rubricas`: reatribuir e desmapear contas, rubricas, contas de caixa, histórico de versões e «Validar versão actual» |
| Página | `/contabilidade/dfc`: colunas N e N-1, cartões-resumo, gráfico, rubricas que abrem as contas, reconciliação com a DRE, painel de impedimentos com «Mapear», badge Provisório e faixa «Mapeamento por validar» |
| Exportação | `GET /api/contabilidade/dfc/export` em PDF |
| RBAC | `financas:fluxo-caixa:{leitura,configurar,validar}`. `:validar` fica só no ADMIN. **Depois do merge é preciso correr `pnpm db:seed`** |

## Commits fora do âmbito da DFC que este ramo leva

- `13c64c2` é o mesmo que o **#222**: repõe os imports de `validations/compras.ts` que o merge do #206 perdeu. Sem ele, a `main` não compila.
- `5944213`: a DRE e o razão passam a ler o dia civil de Maputo e a incluir o último dia. O balancete continua com o defeito. Está num commit à parte para poder ser revertido sozinho.
- O merge de `docs/issue-153-dfc-intencao` (**#209**): intenção, tickets, grafo e prompts.

## Verificação

- `pnpm check`: um único vermelho, `projecao.golden.test.ts`, com «a base tem resíduos». É um compromisso de tesouraria criado à mão na base local e não depende do código.
- `pnpm gates`: todos passam. O `gate-periodo` fica a zero, porque a DFC só lê `Lancamento`.
- `pnpm --filter erp build`: verde. O a11y AA de `/contabilidade/dfc` passa nos dois temas.
- Oráculos:
  - property tests I6–I8 e V1–V4 com 1000 corridas;
  - golden do seed ao cêntimo;
  - I9 contra a DRE em 91 intervalos;
  - I10;
  - configuração V1–V3, com a transição nos dois sentidos;
  - rota de exportação;
  - `e2e/18-dfc.spec.ts`, que percorre o 10.1 pela UI.

## Problemas conhecidos

- **A validação da versão fica às vezes pendurada**, em cerca de 1 submissão em 10. A escrita grava e aparece o toast, mas o botão fica em «A validar…» e a página não navega. Acontece mesmo sem navegação, e três voltas de diagnóstico não chegaram à causa. A edição de rubrica, que tinha um defeito parecido, foi corrigida (0/40). Detalhe em `docs/handoff/dfc-fecho.md`.
- **O `e2e/18-dfc.spec.ts` pode falhar de forma intermitente** no passo 5, provavelmente pela mesma causa. Passou 3/3 no `e2e-v` e 4 de 5 no `fecho`.
- **O parecer do contabilista (nó `parecer`, `[HUMANO]`) continua pendente.** Até lá, o ecrã e o PDF mostram «Mapeamento por validar», e por isso este PR não fecha a #153.
- **Dívida**, consolidada em `docs/handoff/feat-22-fluxo-de-caixa.md`:
  - errata à E2 do ADR;
  - período 13 com o ADR-0035;
  - histórico de versões sem paginação;
  - PDF sem emitente;
  - contraste AA noutras tabelas.

body:
## What changed

- `checkers/src/arch_check/rules/storage.py`, STO-14: the "single `org_id` index beside a compound index it leads" check counts only a non-unique index. A unique index on `org_id` alone (a partial one on a soft-deletable table, for one row per tenant) enforces a rule that no compound index can, so it is not the redundant lookup index the rule is about.
- `lenses/storage.md`, STO-14 **Look for**: says the same in one clause. Principle, severity, and the Check line unchanged; 258 lenses.
- `tests/test_arch_check_storage.py`: a table with a compound `(org_id, deleted_at)` index and a partial unique index on `org_id` passes; replacing the unique index with a plain one is still flagged.

## Why

A soft-deletable table with a per-tenant unique rule (e.g. one installation per tenant, `WHERE deleted_at IS NULL`) that also carries a compound index for its purge was flagged, and the only way out was an exception. The rule meant to catch two lookup indexes where one serves; a uniqueness rule is not one of them.

## Evidence

- The new test fails before the change (`1 failed`) and passes after.
- `make check`: green. `uvx --with pyyaml pytest -q`: 1179 passed.

## Release notes

Fixed: STO-14 no longer flags a unique index on `org_id` beside a compound index that starts with it. Level: patch.

"Row" is the rules' own term for what `Structure` represents: 01 §3 defines a row as same-coloured stones on one line, gaps allowed, and "A row of four stones ..." / "five in a row" build on it. It reads more naturally than "structure", and unlike "sequence" it does not collide with the move sequences the docs talk about.

## Changes

- `Structure` → `Row`, `StructureKind` → `RowKind`, `Structures` (the per-line iterator) → `Rows`
- `src/board/structure.rs` → `src/board/row.rs`
- `structures` / `structures_on` / `structure_starts` → `rows` / `rows_on` / `row_starts`, with tests, comments, docs and CLAUDE.md following
- Where docs and comments said "pattern" for a `Row`, they now say row. The column of stone shapes in the `RowKind` table keeps "Pattern", and the opening patterns in 01 are unrelated.
- Japanese docs: セグメント for `Segment`, 連 for `Row` (the term 01.ja already uses).
- So that "row" means only that, the board's horizontal lines are now called horizontal lines in docs and comments (and columns vertical lines where the two are listed together), e.g. `hlines` / `Direction::Horizontal` and "horizontal line 15 at the top" for the ASCII boards.

The branch went through `Sequence` first (two commits) before settling on `Row`; squash-merging leaves only the end state.

No behaviour change: pure rename. `cargo test --release`, clippy, fmt, rustdoc and the wasm32 build pass; `cargo bench --bench solvers -- --tag quick` gives the same node counts.

body:
Closes #1478

## What
A headless seat whose worker dies with no envelope now gets the existing lost-seat re-ask: one retry, on a fresh worker, under the original assignment id. Two conditions must both hold: the reclaim evidence measures the worker root as dead (`root_liveness === 'dead'`), and the original return path has no envelope bytes. Only ENOENT or a zero-length file counts as empty.

- The retry spends the same one-per-assignment `reasked` grace. A second death, or a death after the grace is spent, propagates `seat-died` as before.
- Only `REASK_TRANSPORTS` are re-asked. headless-json was already in that set, so it is unchanged.
- Pane seats and `no-envelope` are still excluded.
- The new event is `seat-death-reask`. It is registered in `SEAT_REASK_EVENTS` and `JOURNAL_FACT_EVENTS` and ingests into `seat_reasks` with `cause: 'seat-died'`.
- The first death's `seat_died` row (reclaim evidence, original budget) is journalled before the re-ask, and the terminal death gets its own row. Each death is written once.
- A journal that refuses the first death's row does not block the re-ask.

## Evidence
- Gate R1–R5: 5/5 pass.
- Kill-mutations: each was applied to the built text, then the named test and the gate were run, and the file was restored and checked with cmp.

  | id | mutation | named test | gate |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | R1 | remove seat-died from `SEAT_RETRY_KINDS` | red | FAIL R1, R2 |
  | R2 | loop to `SEAT_RETRY_MAX + 1` | red | FAIL R2 |
  | R3 | `noEnvelopeBytes = true` (whole guard) | red | FAIL R3 |
  | R4 | `provenDeath = true` (whole guard) | red | FAIL R4 |
  | R5 | death event renamed to an unregistered name | red | FAIL R1, R5 |
  | RV1-1a | never journal the first death | red | FAIL R1 |
  | RV1-1b | journal the handed-back first death again | red | not covered |

- Suite: 6245 tests, 6238 pass, 0 fail, 7 skipped. Same numbers warm (lane worktree) and cold (fresh detached worktree with the patch applied).
- main ae702428: 6238 tests, 6230 pass, 1 fail, 7 skipped. The failure was a teardown flake in crew-cli.test.mjs (`ENOTEMPTY` from `rmSync`), and the file passed 184/184 on three reruns.

- Sol: pass 1 passed; pass 2 found one must-fix (fixed); pass 3 passed.

## Done by hand
The lane escalated at scope-gate with `anchor-absent`: the plan's find text for R1 and R3 no longer matched the built guard. I finished it by hand:
- Re-bound R1 and R3 against the built text and re-ran all eight mutations (table above).
- Reviewed round 5's fix for the RV1-1 must-fix. Both death rows are journalled, and the seat-io-death budget test pins the first row at the original budget again.
- Fixed a duplicate first-death row that appeared when the re-ask was undelivered or its second failure was not a death.
- Fixed Sol pass 2's must-fix: the first-death journal write is now wrapped so it cannot throw into the re-ask.

author: ampilarey
body:
BOOKSHOP_PLAN slice B3 (one slice, one PR). A shop can send an order; the customer can follow it, cancel it, return part of it and talk to the shop. STATUS §5ha has the full account.

## What a person can do

- **Shop** (`/vendor/orders`, *Orders* on the portal home): a queue with tabs and counts; move an order through processing → ready to collect *or* dispatched (carrier, tracking note) → delivered/collected; print the delivery label and packing slip; cancel with a reason before it leaves; accept a return (restock or not) or decline it with a reason; confirm a bank-transfer slip on its own single-shop checkout; write to the customer; CSV.
- **Owner** (`/vendor`): return window (7 days minimum, decision 8) and conditions; holiday mode with dates and a notice.
- **Customer** (`/my-orders/{number}`): progress and tracking; cancel before dispatch; ask for a return inside the window; see refunds; write to the shop on a Messages thread.
- **Office** (`/admin/bookshop`): card refunds to record once returned through BML (or credit the wallet instead); CSV.

## Money (rules 11, 12; audit finding 6)

- One refund path for cancellations and returns, capped at the order's total less what already went back.
- Wallet → credited back at once on Commerce's append-only ledger. Bank transfer → back to the wallet at once through `RefundPaymentAction`. Card → pending until the office records it through `RefundPaymentAction` (`manual` or `wallet`).
- **B2 change:** confirming a bank-transfer slip now records a Finance manual payment (`RecordManualPaymentAction`, `bank_transfer`), which fires the same `PaymentConfirmed` as a card and gives the refund a payment to go back against. The listener keeps the payment id on the checkout.
- A return is worth its share of the goods after the discount. When it was the shop's fault, the delivery fee goes back too, once per order.

## Other

- Holiday mode is worked out from its dates (no scheduler job). Decision 15: the shop's queue and CSV mask the customer's phone and street once the order closed and its return window passed.
- Data: one additive migration (fulfilment timestamps, cancellation, carrier/tracking, thread id on `orders`; return window/conditions on `vendors`; new `order_returns`, `order_refunds`, both aliased in the morph map).
- **Found and fixed (B2's):** a plain `throttle:N,1` keys on the user alone, so ten cart adds in a minute got the checkout a 429. Each bookstore limit now has its own prefix. The same pattern on ~30 other routes is recorded in `KNOWN_ISSUES`, not fixed here (rule 1).

## Tests and walks

- `BookshopFulfilmentTest` (8), a long-basket case in `BookshopCheckoutTest` (fails with 429 on the old routes). `VendorScopeIsTheOnlyDoorTest` now also covers `VendorOrderController`; the route sweep declares the slip file. **Full suite 2225 passed.**
- `scripts/smoke/fulfilment.mjs` **21/21** (three runs back to back); `checkout.mjs` **28/28** three times after it was made to wait for Blade navigations it had been racing; `shop.mjs` **24/24**; `vendor.mjs` **25/25**. No console or server errors.
- Not walked: the office recording a card refund, since card payment cannot complete until `BML_WEBHOOK_SECRET` exists. Covered by the feature test with a faked gateway.

## Production

`php artisan migrate --force`. No seeder, no new setting.

author: thijs-creemers
body:
After #563 the run is slot-bound: 20 concurrent jobs, and E2E waited 150s behind the isolation cells.

- The 20 Babashka-only jobs are one `checks` job, one step per gate, each `if: !cancelled()` so every failing gate still shows.
- The isolation matrix is 5 jobs of 6 libraries. Each library still loads in its own JVM from its own `deps.edn`; the job names every library that fails.
- `matrix-covers-every-library` reads the groups and fails on a library listed twice.

~93 jobs per run → ~49.

author: marciclabas
body:
Closes #189

Bybit and Binance block this environment (HTTP 403 / 451), so Bybit findings rest on the issue's venue rows plus independent corroboration, and Binance findings were re-read from `data-api.binance.vision`, which serves the same `/api/v3` data. MEXC, Bitget, CoinGecko, CoinMarketCap's web API, Twelve Data and Yahoo Finance were reachable directly. All prices below were read at 2026-09-26 06:1x–06:2x UTC.

## Changes

### Delistings (findings 5–11, 39)

- **bybit `spot:ICXUSDT`, `spot:LUNCUSDC`, `spot:NEONUSDT`, `spot:SANDUSDC`, `spot:SUNDOGUSDT`, `spot:SWELLUSDC`, `spot:TACUSDT`** → `delisted: true`, trading-page URLs dropped. Corroborated independently of the issue: of the 534 Bybit spot pairs CoinMarketCap tracks (`api.coinmarketcap.com/data-api/v3/exchange/market-pairs/latest?slug=bybit&category=spot`), exactly these seven stopped updating on 2026-09-24 (`lastUpdated` 2026-09-24T07:57–08:06Z, `volumeExcluded: 1`) while the other 527 updated today — the signature of the venue pulling the pairs, matching the harness reading them as absent from Bybit's API.
- **mexc `perp:ETHFI_USDC`** → `delisted: true`, URL dropped. `contract.mexc.com/api/v1/contract/detail` returns 1184 contracts and no `ETHFI_USDC`; `ETHFI_USDT` is still there, so only the USDC pair is gone.

### Bybit tokenized equity perpetuals (findings 1–2)

Both assets and Bybit translations already existed; only the instruments were missing.

- **`perp:AMZUUSDT`** → `direxion-daily-amzn-bull-2x` / tether / tether. Issue row: `symbolType: "stock"`, `status: "Trading"`, last 34.31; AMZU (Direxion Daily AMZN Bull 2X Shares, NasdaqGM) was 34.23 on Yahoo Finance.
- **`perp:TLTUSDT`** → `ishares-20-year-treasury-bond-etf` / tether / tether. Issue row: `symbolType: "ETF"`, `status: "Trading"`, bid 79.69; TLT (iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF) was 79.32 on Yahoo Finance.

### Bitget (findings 3, 16, 17)

All three confirmed live in `api.bitget.com/api/v2/mix/market/contracts?productType=usdt-futures` (`symbolStatus: "normal"`), prices from `/api/v2/mix/market/tickers`:

- **`usdt:CORZUSDT`** → `core-scientific` (asset and translation already existed). Bitget 17.287 vs CORZ 17.34 (Yahoo, NasdaqGS).
- **`URNM`** → `sprott-uranium-miners-etf` + **`usdt:URNMUSDT`**. Bitget 49.30 vs URNM 49.13 (Yahoo, NYSE Arca); Twelve Data confirms the ETF.
- **`WBD`** → `warner-bros-discovery` + **`usdt:WBDUSDT`**. Bitget 30.903 vs WBD 30.86 (Twelve Data, NASDAQ).

### Binance HYPE spot pairs (findings 36–38)

`HYPE` already mapped to `hyperliquid`; added `spot:HYPEUSDT`, `spot:HYPEUSDC`, `spot:HYPETRY`. All three `TRADING` in `exchangeInfo` (last 91.64 / 91.61 / 4465.00 TRY), and CoinMarketCap lists HYPE/USDT, HYPE/USDC and HYPE/TRY on Binance against currency id 32196 (Hyperliquid).

### Binance bStocks (findings 12–14, 29–30)

Binance suffixes tokenized equities with `B` — its live symbol list has AAPLB, TSLAB, NVDAB, SPYB and 80-odd others — and the catalogue already models these as separate `rwa` assets pegged to the underlying share (`gopro-bstock`, `reddit-bstock`). Identity per market pair came from CoinMarketCap's Binance pair list, then each id was resolved on its own:

| Venue asset | New asset | CoinMarketCap | Contract (BEP-20) | Price check |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AGPUB` | `axe-compute-bstock`, pegged to `axe-compute` | 42353 `axe-compute-tokenized-bstocks`, 12.4604 | `0xa455ae0f04a2b86eee47adca98985e61d14cbefb` | Binance 12.46 vs AGPU 12.09 (Yahoo/Twelve Data, NasdaqCM) |
| `CYPHB` | `cypherpunk-technologies-bstock`, pegged to `cypherpunk-technologies` | 42354 `cypherpunk-technologies-tokenized-bstocks`, 4.0832 | `0x0393c28065c54e48b45bdb05eff5c401cf891da1` | Binance 4.09 vs CYPH 4.12 |
| `AMCB` | `amc-entertainment-bstock`, pegged to new `amc-entertainment` (AMC, NYSE) | 42355 `amc-entertainment-holdings-tokenized-bstocks`, 2.9262 | `0x96e7d606e229448ef817a7f35fd7394c3e15d00c` | Binance 2.93 vs AMC 2.94 |

Markets added: `spot:AGPUBUSDT`, `spot:CYPHBUSDT` and `spot:AMCBUSDT` — the last is not itself a finding, but finding 13 saw `AMCB` in a market and `AMCBUSDT` is `TRADING` with $40k 24h quote volume, so it is mapped with the other two. Issuer wording follows the existing bStock records and the launch announcement (BTech Holdings Limited, prospectuses approved by the ADGM FSRA, BEP-20 on BNB Chain, 1:1 backing and conversion). The three BEP-20 addresses are *not* added to `data/asset_translations/bnb-chain.json`, since that needs on-chain verification and is outside these findings.

### MEXC tokenized equity perpetuals (findings 18–19, 22–28, 40–41, 34)

MEXC's own contract rows name the underlying in their `fn` field, and every price matches the named listing. Translations keyed on `baseCoin` as the existing `*STOCK` entries are; instruments added as `perp` / tether / tether.

| Venue asset | MEXC `fn` | New asset | Listing | MEXC last vs listing |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `PFESTOCK` | Pfizer | `pfizer` | PFE, NYSE | 28.65 vs 28.67 (Twelve Data) |
| `AKAMSTOCK` | Akamai Technologies, Inc. | `akamai` | AKAM, NASDAQ | 113.58 vs 113.94 |
| `VICRSTOCK` | Vicor | `vicor` | VICR, NASDAQ | 284.4 vs 281.96 |
| `TSMCSTOCK` | Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing | `taiwan-semiconductor` (2330) | TWSE 2330 | 78.04 vs TWD 2475 × 0.0316 = 78.21 |
| `MEDIATEKSTOCK` | MediaTek | `mediatek` (2454) | TWSE 2454 | 166.4 vs TWD 5285 → 167.0 |
| `DELTAELECSTOCK` | Delta Electronics | `delta-electronics` (2308) | TWSE 2308 | 60.12 vs TWD 1910 → 60.4 |
| `UMCSTOCK` | United Microelectronics | `united-microelectronics` (2303) | TWSE 2303 | 4.94 vs TWD 154 → 4.87 |
| `HK0992` | Lenovo | `lenovo-group` (0992) | HKEX 0992 | 36.96 vs HKD 37.16 (see note) |
| `TMOSTOCK` | Thermo Fisher Scientific | existing `thermo-fisher-scientific` | TMO, NYSE | 666.78 vs 675 |
| `WBDSTOCK` | Warner Bros Discovery | existing `warner-bros-discovery` | WBD, NASDAQ | 30.91 vs 30.86 |

The Taiwan-listed records are deliberately distinct from the existing `taiwan-semiconductor-adr` (TSM): TSM was 450.61 while the contract tracks the ordinary share, and the same holds for UMC (ADR 24.31 vs ordinary 4.94). This follows the `kokusai-electric` (6525) precedent, whose MEXC contract likewise converts the local listing to USD (59.85 vs JPY 9300).

**Note for review — HK0992 quoting.** MEXC converts the Taiwan and Japan listings to USD but quotes its HK-prefixed contracts in HKD numerals: HK0992 is 36.96 against Lenovo's HKD 37.16 (≈ USD 4.76), and the same holds for its other HK contracts (HK0700 437.26 vs Tencent HKD 436.6; HK1810 25.89 vs Xiaomi HKD 25.9). The identity is unambiguous — `HK0992` is HKEX code 0992 and MEXC names it Lenovo — so it is mapped, but the schema has no way to record that the price is in HKD while settlement is USDT. Worth a decision if more HK contracts get mapped.

### MEXC NEAR-ecosystem perpetuals (findings 32–33)

- **`AURORA`** → new `aurora` + **`perp:AURORA_USDT`**. CoinGecko `aurora-near` (Aurora, EVM on NEAR, https://aurora.dev/) at 0.0731 and CoinMarketCap 14803 vs MEXC 0.07347. Distinct from the existing `aurora-dao` (IDEX).
- **`RHEA`** → new `rhea-finance` + **`perp:RHEA_USDT`**. CoinGecko `rhea-2` (RHEA Finance, https://rhea.finance/, NEAR token `token.rhealab.near`, Ref + Burrow) at 0.0861 and CoinMarketCap 37529 (`rhea-finance`) vs MEXC 0.0866.

`scripts/instrument_urls.py` generated all new trading-page URLs; `scripts/validate.py` and `scripts/check_new_assets.py --base <base>` both pass.

## Unchanged

- **15 `untranslated-asset` bitget `POLYMARKET`** and **31 `untranslated-market` bitget `usdt:POLYMARKETUSDT`** — needs a human decision. The contract is live (24.148, $484k 24h volume) but it is a pre-IPO perpetual on privately held Polymarket's valuation, not a token: there is no listed equity and no verifiable price-provider identity for it. author: alex-wengg
body:
Core ML export of [jaredpalmer/kev-0.8b](https://huggingface.co/jaredpalmer/kev-0.8b), published as [FluidInference/kev-0.8b-coreml](https://huggingface.co/FluidInference/kev-0.8b-coreml).

- Row packages (`KevRow`, L512_K16 / L1024_K80): Kev's own benchmark reproduces the published numbers, 1/764 (transfer-v4) and 2/1,468 (decision-v7) top-answer flips vs Kev fp32.
- `FusedPass` (`kev_stages.py`): state + all questions in one call, packed under a segment mask (attention mask, segment-local decay, WY triangle), conv lags from the state's tail. fp32 parity vs `KevRow`: 0 flips, max |Δp| 3e-6 with every question packed 3x.
- `_masked_block_inverse`: the WY inverse as `D_2s = D_s − D_s (t ⊙ M_s) D_s`, 4 ops per level; it was half of a small call's time. A Neumann/doubling inverse is not viable (powers reach 3e35).
- `convert-stages.py` + `combine-stages.py`: weight-shared multifunction package; `kev_benchmark_coreml.py --fused`.

M5 Pro, GPU, Swift, Kev's `serving_bench.py` shapes vs Kev's MLX server: 18.1 / 37.8 / 64.1 ms vs 26.6 / 51.5 / 69.6 ms. ANE is not a fit for this backbone (one call: GPU 30.8 ms, CPU + ANE 740 ms). Details in the README.

author: 0chord
body:
포트의 인자·반환값에 JDBC·Spring·영속 모델이 노출돼도 기존 검사로는 잡지 못했습니다. ARCH-06을 추가해 **등록된 포트의 공개 계약에 기술 타입이 드러나면 구조 검사를 실패**시키며, 대상이나 필요한 정의가 빠지면 통과 대신 준비 실패로 보고합니다.

Refs #19 — 이번 PR은 ARCH-06입니다. ARCH-08 및 ARCH-03/04/05 예제 검증은 남아 있으므로 #19를 종료하지 않습니다.

## 리뷰 보완

최신 독립 리뷰에서 발견한 **공개 inner 클래스의 바깥 타입 변수 연결 누락**을 보완했습니다. `Box<T>`의 T 상한에 JDBC가 있고 `Inner.load()`가 T를 반환하면, 이제 Box 상한과 Inner 반환의 두 위치를 모두 보고합니다. 원본의 실제 포함 관계를 따라 바깥 변수를 해석하고, inner·메서드의 새 변수와 구분하며 static 경계에서는 바깥 탐색을 중단합니다. 필요한 내부/외부 바깥 정의가 없으면 준비 실패로 처리합니다.

앞선 소유 타입·외부 중첩 계약 누락에 이어, 후속 P3인 **같은 이름의 클래스/메서드 타입 변수 혼동**을 보완했습니다. 클래스 상한은 클래스 선언 범위에서 먼저 해석하고 메서드 변수와 분리합니다. 클래스 `U extends T`의 반환·인자·상한 위반을 빠뜨리지 않고, 메서드 자체 변수나 정상 클래스 반환값에 다른 선언의 기술 상한을 잘못 적용하지 않습니다.

소유 타입 인자와 외부 상위의 공개 중첩 계약 검사는 유지합니다. 내부 출력 누락·외부 파일 누락·원본 삭제/손상은 준비 실패로 처리하며, 일반 값 허용 사례도 유지했습니다.

**확정한 static 경계:** 사용자 합의에 따라 상위 인터페이스의 static 메서드는 자식 포트의 계약·진단·계약 수에서 제외합니다. 포트 자신이 선언한 static과 상속한 일반/default 메서드는 계속 검사합니다. 부모를 별도 포트로 등록하면 부모 static의 위반은 부모에게 보고합니다. 기존 공개 중첩 계약도 유지합니다.

`9406277` 독립 재리뷰에서 기존 댓글 3건과 static 변경을 확인했고, 바깥·inner 변수 연결 P3을 추가로 발견했습니다. 이번 수정의 독립 재리뷰는 아직입니다. 기존 리뷰 기록과 해결되지 않은 스레드는 그대로 보존합니다.

## 변경 전체 흐름

| 흐름 | 입력 → 판단 → 결과 |
| --- | --- |
| 자료 준비 | 기존 운영 출력·모듈 등록·역할 분류 → 포트/영속 정의와 소속 확인 → 정상 입력만 평가. 빈 등록·누락·잘못된 포트·미해석 상위 계약은 준비 실패 |
| 계약 추출 | 등록된 포트 → 공개 메서드·필드·어노테이션·throws·상속·중첩/companion 계약 읽기 → 배열·제네릭·상한 안쪽 타입과 바깥 선언의 타입 변수까지 수집. 상위 인터페이스 static·private·메서드 본문·임의 DTO 내부는 제외 |
| 판정·보고 | 노출 타입 → 기존 기술 정책 및 ARCH-06 추가 정책·영속 역할과 비교 → 허용 또는 선언/노출 자리/대상 타입을 담은 위반. 중복 상속·JVM 브리지는 같은 계약의 중복 보고를 제거 |
| 실제 적용 | 기존 테스트 모듈의 P03 → 운영 포트 5개·공개 계약 11개에 같은 검사 적용 → 준비 오류 0·위반 0. 기존 check/build에서 실행 |

준비 실패 시 일부만 검사한 결과를 정상으로 표시하지 않습니다. 검사 중 포트 메서드나 저장 구현을 호출하지 않으며 DB 연결·거래 상태 변경은 없습니다. 저장 구현의 SQL·트랜잭션 동작은 변경하지 않았습니다.

[전체 자연어 흐름·테스트별 근거·파일 역할](https://github.com/0Chord/coin-exchange/blob/ecd58448f93468b525111562a36f8ff1f009f564/engineering/architecture-06-review.md) · [ARCH-06 명세](https://github.com/0Chord/coin-exchange/blob/ecd58448f93468b525111562a36f8ff1f009f564/engineering/architecture-check-spec.md)

## 먼저 판단할 사례

**저장 구현이 `Connection`을 쓰는 것은 허용하고, 포트가 `Connection`을 반환하면 실패한다.** 호출자가 DB 기술까지 알아야 하는 계약을 막기 위한 구분입니다. 구현체의 모든 의존을 포트 위반으로 처리하면 의도한 저장 어댑터까지 거절하게 됩니다.

- [공개 계약을 읽는 코드](https://github.com/0Chord/coin-exchange/blob/ecd58448f93468b525111562a36f8ff1f009f564/architecture-tests/src/test/kotlin/com/exchange/architecture/rules/PortContractReader.kt)와 [타입 판정·준비 실패·보고 코드](https://github.com/0Chord/coin-exchange/blob/ecd58448f93468b525111562a36f8ff1f009f564/architecture-tests/src/test/kotlin/com/exchange/architecture/rules/PortContractIndependence.kt)를 확인합니다.
- [PORT-02 직접 노출 거절·PORT-10 저장 구현 허용 테스트](https://github.com/0Chord/coin-exchange/blob/ecd58448f93468b525111562a36f8ff1f009f564/architecture-tests/src/test/kotlin/com/exchange/architecture/PortContractRuleTest.kt)가 양쪽 기대값을 확인합니다. 위반 예제를 검사기가 잡았기 때문에 테스트가 통과하는 방식입니다.
- 다음 판단은 전체 흐름 문서의 **누락 시 미평가**, **상속·제네릭 공개 범위**, **같은 계약만 중복 제거**, **실제 포트 5개 적용** 순서로 연결했습니다.

## 변경 파일의 역할

15개 파일, 제품 실행 코드 변경 없음.

- 검사 도구: `PortContractReader`, `PortContractIndependence`가 추출·판정·보고를 담당합니다. `PortContractBytecode`가 원본 Signature와 중첩 선언을 보완합니다.
- 기존 검사 지원: `ExternalTechnologyTypes`로 ARCH-01의 동일한 기술 목록을 추출했습니다. ARCH-06 추가 정책은 분리해 ARCH-01의 범위를 확대하지 않습니다.
- 운영 연결: `ProductionScope`의 영속 모델 등록과 `ProductionArchitectureTest`의 P03을 추가했습니다.
- 테스트와 예제: `PortContractRuleTest` 47개, Kotlin·Java·외부 계약 예제로 정상·위반·누락·브리지 계약을 검증합니다. 예제 메서드는 제품 기능이 아니며 실행하지 않습니다.
- 빌드·문서: 테스트용 transaction/Jackson 의존성과 명세·흐름·검증 기록을 포함합니다. 생성 HTML은 로컬 열람용이며 원격 리뷰는 위 저장소 문서로 가능합니다.

## 검증

검증 대상: `ecd58448f93468b525111562a36f8ff1f009f564`. 코드·빌드 파일 12개의 SHA-256이 로컬 실행 기록과 일치합니다.

- 새 회귀 테스트 8개: 리뷰 반례와 직접 타입 반환 대조, 필드·인자·상한, 일반 값, 다단계/이름 가림, static 경계, 상위 inner 우선 탐색, 내부·외부 바깥 정의 누락.
- 수정 전 **47개 중 6개 실패**: 진단 누락 4개, 필요한 바깥 정의 누락을 미평가하지 않은 2개를 확인했습니다. 정상 값·static 경계는 기존 동작 유지 사례입니다.
- 수정 후 포트 계약 **47개 통과**. 이전 독립 리뷰의 Java 반례도 기대값을 유지하고 수정본으로 다시 실행해 exit 0을 확인했습니다. 작성자의 재실행이며 새 독립 리뷰는 아닙니다.
- 최종 build에서 **구조 검사 129개 실행·통과**, 실패·오류·skip 0. 운영 포트 5개·공개 계약 11개, 준비 오류·위반 0.

```sh
./gradlew :architecture-tests:test --tests '*PortContractRuleTest' --no-daemon --console=plain
./gradlew build --no-daemon --console=plain --continue
```

최종 build는 1개 작업 실행·29개 UP-TO-DATE였습니다. 다른 모듈은 기존 통과 결과를 재사용했습니다. XML 합계 **372개(구조 129개 + 기존 제품 243개)**를 이번에 전부 재실행한 것은 아닙니다.

[실행 명령·집계·운영 결과·소스 해시](https://github.com/0Chord/coin-exchange/blob/ecd58448f93468b525111562a36f8ff1f009f564/engineering/architecture-06-verification.json)에 이번 기록과 앞선 이력을 보존했습니다. `/tmp` 로그·이전 리뷰 반례는 로컬 보조 자료이고, 대응하는 8개 회귀 테스트는 저장소에 포함합니다. 이번 커밋의 원격 CI는 PR Checks에서 확인합니다.

author: ohchankyu
body:
## What

Three things the rc3 changes got wrong, found by running rc3 on a real codebase. Two are regressions from #36 and #37, one is a gap in #36's design.

1. **`executeInTransaction` was exempted.** #37 made "the producer saw `beginTransaction`" the exemption, which also covers `KafkaTemplate.executeInTransaction`: a local Kafka transaction that commits on its own, before the database does. A rollback cannot unsend it, which is exactly the case the detector exists for. rc2 reported it; rc3 did not.
2. **A suspended Kafka transaction was reported under open-in-view.** #36 judged a scope without synchronization as still open when any resource was bound to the thread. OSIV keeps an entity manager bound for the whole request, so `NOT_SUPPORTED` inside a `KafkaTransactionManager` transaction still looked open.
3. **A slow inner `REQUIRES_NEW` transaction in FAIL mode caused a partial commit.** The exception from the inner `afterCommit` reached the outer method and rolled the outer transaction back around the committed inner one.

## Changes

- `PuretxProducerProxy`: exempt only when the producer is in a Kafka transaction **and** Spring has bound a `KafkaResourceHolder` to the thread, which it does when tying a Kafka transaction to its own and never does for a local one. Looked up by type, not factory, so the copied-factory case from #37 stays fixed
- Each scope carries its manager's own resource key (`ResourceTransactionManager.getResourceFactory()`, or the producer factory for `KafkaTransactionManager`, resolved through a class only loaded when Spring Kafka is present). The probe checks that key alone
- `reportLongTransaction` records and returns the violation instead of throwing. The listener decides: on a rollback nothing is thrown; inside an enclosing scope the failure is deferred to it; otherwise it throws. "The test fails and the data stays" now holds at every depth
- From the same review: `ImpureTransactionException` message includes the call path; the no-transaction-manager warning keeps the tally; a debug line when two managers are completed out of order; README says `executeInTransaction` is reported and how a Kafka send is timed

## Tests

Each has a test that fails on `main`: `reportsALocalKafkaTransactionInsideADatabaseTransaction`, `staysQuietWhileSuspendedDespiteUnrelatedResources` (an unrelated resource bound, `NOT_SUPPORTED` inside a Kafka transaction), `slowInnerTransactionFailsAfterTheOuterCommit` (two rows survive, both violations recorded, inner first). The Kafka exemption tests from #37 are rewritten around the holder. 126 tests pass on Boot 3.2.12, 3.5.16 and 4.1.1.
